Subject: Unexpected throughput drop this morning (AltoBank)

Sofia —

We started seeing a large number of 429s and queueing from 08:45 PST. Our dashboard shows reserved throughput dropping ~35% versus our committed baseline for the last two hours. This is impacting our realtime scoring pipeline (fraud model) and causing retries across services.

Can Redwood confirm whether this is an isolated hotpath in our dedicated pool or something broader? We need immediate mitigation and an estimate for when normal throughput will resume. Procurement also wants to know whether this will affect the committed SLA for Nov.

Attached a short metrics export and the mutual action plan we shared last quarter.

—Alice

I'll follow up with an ops readout within 30 minutes.

Alice/Sofia —

Initial findings from the cluster: your reserved pool is experiencing sustained KV-cache eviction events and a sudden increase in prefix-miss rates on two GPU hosts (host-gpu-17 and host-gpu-18). We also see a correlated spike in continuous-batching latencies from an unrelated tenant that started ~08:30.

Immediate remediation plan (30/60/240 min):
- 0-30m: Redirect AltoBank hotpath traffic to the reserved warm-standby pool (temporary routing) to recover throughput and lower 429s.
- 30-60m: Authorize a short-term burst allocation (2x vslots) from Dedicated spare capacity to relieve KV pressure while we identify noisy neighbor.
- 60-240m: Live kernel profile + KV-usage dump, followed by a slot realignment; if noisy-tenant persists we'll evict lower-tier workloads from those hosts.

Impact to SLA/committed throughput: if we take the short-term routing + burst steps now we expect recovery to >95% of baseline within 45 minutes. If remediation is delayed beyond 2 hours, we may need to issue credits per contract.

Requesting authorization to take the short-term burst now. Sofia/Vivek — if we get signoff I'll execute and confirm when traffic flips.

Jonas Weber
Head of SRE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-22T17:43:00-08:00
Subject: AltoBank capacity shortfall — exec readout and next steps

Bob/Alice —

Short executive readout after the remediation steps we took Monday morning: 

What happened
- Root cause: KV-cache pressure on two hosts in your reserved pool caused disproportionate eviction and raised per-request latency. A simultaneous noisy-tenant continuous-batch spike amplified queuing (not related to AltoBank workloads).

What we did
- 2026-11-20 10:10 PST: Rerouted hotpath to reserved warm-standby pool and applied a 2x burst allocation to AltoBank for 90 minutes. Traffic recovery to >95% baseline by 10:55 PST.
- 10:55-13:20 PST: Live profiling + kernel swap; identified a mis-configured batch-size heuristic on the noisy tenant and patched their runtime (eviction dropped ~80%).
- 13:30 PST: Realigned AltoBank slots to hosts with larger KV footprints and enabled prefix-level caching for your primary route.

Current status
- Throughput and 5xx/429 rate have returned to expected ranges. We are monitoring with a 72-hour elevated alert window.

Follow-ups and asks
- Short-term: we recommend a one-time procurement amendment to add a 12-hour burst credit to your contract to cover emergency allocations during Q4 peaks. This avoids immediate credit disputes and keeps your pipelines running during future neighbor noise.
- Medium-term: schedule a joint SRE+Platform review to adjust per-route cache sizing and to set a lower-bound preemption policy; Jonas suggested host-level affinity changes.
- Exec: if you want an SLA credit estimate and formal customer-facing incident report, we'll deliver that within 48 hours.

Marissa is looping in our renewals team to model the procurement amendment and Vivek will coordinate the joint SRE review. Jonas: please attach the profiling dump + short mitigation timeline when you have it.

Apologies for the disruption — we take reserved throughput commitments seriously and will adjust tooling to reduce recurrence risk.

Best regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai

---
Jonas Weber will attach the kernel profile & trace in a follow-up. Marissa will propose amendment language and cost estimate. Vivek will set the SRE+Alto calendar invite.
